title: Art. 2.5.2 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 5, Paragraph 2
content: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman, or degrading punishment or treatment. All persons deprived of their liberty shall be treated with respect for the inherent dignity of the human person.
